concepts.definition: the smallest particle of an element that retains the chemical properties of that element
a pure substance made of only one type of atom
a pure substance formed when two or more elements are chemically combined in fixed proportions
a physical combination of substances whose components retain their individual properties
the amount of substance containing Avogadro's number of specified particles
a substance that produces hydrogen ions in aqueous solution or donates protons
a substance that accepts protons or produces hydroxide ions in aqueous solution
a chemical process involving loss of electrons or an increase in oxidation number
a substance that changes the rate of a reaction without being consumed overall
an arrangement of chemical elements by atomic number that reveals recurring trends in their properties
